summary: This document defines a BGP Extended Community that travels with an Ethernet VPN (EVPN) MAC/IP Advertisement route and carries ARP and Neighbor Discovery related flags. With it, a Provider Edge router doing proxy ARP/ND, or ARP/ND on an IRB interface, can answer ARP Requests or Neighbor Solicitations with correct information.

eli5.summary: When someone asks who owns an address, a helper can answer on behalf of the owner if it was told the details beforehand. This document adds a small label so helpers get the details they need to answer correctly.

questions: evpn arp nd flags extended community
